references.text: Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of God Most High, who blessed Abraham
You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek
Abram himself uses the title 'Lord, God Most High, maker of heaven and earth'
Isaac blesses Jacob: May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful
The earth and everything in it belongs to the Lord, the world and those who live in it
Blessed are you by the Lord, the Maker of heaven and earth
Psalm 115:15 repeats the theological formula from Melchizedek that blessing comes from the Creator of heaven and earth.
The specific blessing in 14:19 is the basis for the prophecy that all nations will be blessed through Abraham in 18:18.
Paul interprets and summarizes the theology that believers share in the blessing given to Abraham.
Hermes uses the same liturgical formula as Melchizedek, grounding praise in God's role as Creator.
The psalm uses an identical liturgical formula to Melchizedek, where the blessing is rooted in God's role as Creator.
